readme:
# Rakuten Ichiba Scraper

Get product results from [Rakuten Ichiba](https://www.rakuten.co.jp/), Japan's largest online mall. Enter search phrases, or paste the address of a search page, and the actor returns one record per product on the result pages: title, item link, price in yen, shop name and link, reward points, free shipping flag, delivery line, review score and count, image and position. No login and no API key are needed.

## What you get

- One record per product from the search result pages, about 45 products per page.
- Several pages per search in one run. Set `maxResults` and the actor reads as many pages as it needs.
- Several searches in one run. Each search phrase and each start URL has its own `maxResults`.
- Each product once per search, even when it shows up on more than one page. Sponsored cards repeat products from the normal list and are left out.
- A run that is interrupted continues where it stopped. Rows already delivered are not delivered or charged again.
- You pay only for rows that were saved to the dataset.

## Use with AI agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client, such as Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain or LlamaIndex.

**MCP server URL:**

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/rakuten-ichiba-scraper
```

**Example prompt once connected:**

> "Use `rakuten-ichiba-scraper` to find the 50 cheapest rice cookers on Rakuten Ichiba and list price, shop and review score as a CSV."

## Data extracted

| Field | Example |
|-------|---------|
| `item_id` | `"10000552"` |
| `item_code` | `"n14dp9"` |
| `shop_id`, `shop_code` | `"412923"`, `"digitalcon"` |
| `shop_name` | `"デジタルライフストア"` |
| `shop_url` | `"https://www.rakuten.co.jp/digitalcon/"` |
| `url` | `"https://item.rakuten.co.jp/digitalcon/n14dp9/"` |
| `title` | Product title as shown on the card |
| `price` | `29800` (yen, tax included) |
| `price_max` | `66900`, when the card shows a range |
| `price_from` | `true` when the card shows a starting price |
| `currency` | `"JPY"` |
| `points`, `points_text` | `2700`, `"2,700ポイント(1倍+9倍UP)〜"` |
| `free_shipping` | `true` |
| `shipping_text` | `"11/7 12:00までの注文で最短11/8お届け"` |
| `rating`, `review_count` | `3.67`, `9` |
| `review_url` | Link to the item's reviews |
| `image_url` | Product image |
| `labels` | `["中古"]` (used), when shown |
| `badges` | Shop and delivery marks, for example `["39(サンキュー)ショップ"]` |
| `genre_id` | Rakuten category number |
| `variant_id` | Variant code shown on the card |
| `item_type` | `"NORMAL"` |
| `position`, `position_on_page`, `page` | `3`, `3`, `1` |
| `search_query` | `"laptop"` |
| `total_results` | `120880`, the count the site reports for the search |
| `source_url` | The page the row came from |
| `scraped_at` | `"2026-11-06T09:00:00Z"` |

Fields that a card does not show are returned as `null`. Products without reviews have no `rating`.

## Pricing

Pay-per-event pricing. You pay only for rows that were saved to the dataset.

| Event | Price |
|-------|-------|
| Actor start (`actor-start`) | $0.001 |
| Product scraped (`rakuten-ichiba-result`) | $1.50 / 1,000 |

The start event is charged once per run, together with the first saved row. A run that returns nothing is not charged. If you set a maximum cost per run, the actor stops before it goes over that limit.

## Input

| Field | Type | Description | Default |
|-------|------|-------------|---------|
| `searchQueries` | string[] | Words to search for, in Japanese or English, for example `laptop` or `炊飯器`. | none |
| `startUrls` | string[] | Plain search page addresses such as `https://search.rakuten.co.jp/search/mall/laptop/`. Addresses that the site's robots.txt does not allow, such as sort, price filter or category pages, are skipped. | none |
| `maxResults` | integer | Most products to return for each search phrase and each start URL. 0 uses 50. | `50` |

At least one of `searchQueries` or `startUrls` is required.

## Usage examples

### Two searches, 50 products each

```json
{
  "searchQueries": ["laptop", "rice cooker"],
  "maxResults": 50
}
```

### A search page address

```json
{
  "startUrls": ["https://search.rakuten.co.jp/search/mall/laptop/"],
  "maxResults": 90
}
```

## Limitations

- The actor reads search result pages. It does not open item pages, so it does not return item descriptions, stock or the full list of variants.
- Prices, points and delivery lines are those shown to a visitor in Japan at the time of the request. They change during the day and with campaigns.
- Prices shown as a starting price (`price_from` is `true`) are the lowest variant price. `price_max` holds the highest when the card shows it.
- Rakuten limits how many result pages a search can reach. A run ends when the site stops returning new products.
- The actor follows the site's robots.txt, so it does not sort results or apply price filters. Results come in the site's default order.
- Sponsored cards are not returned because they repeat products that are already in the normal list.
- Titles, shop names and delivery lines are in Japanese.
- The site changes its page layout from time to time. If a page cannot be read, the run says so and nothing is charged.

## FAQ

**Which pages should I use?**
Search phrases are the simplest. You can also paste a plain search page address.

**How many products can I get from one search?**
The site reports the number of matches, often tens of thousands, but a search page list is limited by the site. The actor reads pages until it has `maxResults` products or the list ends.

**What does a run cost?**
The start price plus the result price per 1,000 rows. A run of 50 products is 50 rows plus one start.

**What status does a run end with?**
The run status says how many rows were delivered. If the site refuses every request, the run fails and nothing is charged. If a search matches nothing, the run ends normally and says so.

**Can I get reviews or item details?**
This actor returns the data shown on search result cards: price, shop, points, shipping line and review summary. It does not return review text or item page details.
